issues.finding: The actual cause was an upstream source import omission. The importer skipped Devil Spider's 0x150 descriptor, 92-byte vertices and kind-9 triangle batch, then mislabeled a web helper as the costume. The recovered original BDAE body contains 1819 vertices and 3058 triangles, uses its authored opaque 1024x1024 material and retains exact raw skin weights. Corrected native swing and crouch captures show the body. No loader dimension or memory limit was increased.
issues.resolution: Installed a hash-checked corrected derived FBX conversion, with source originals and the previous installed actor retained. Full animation, web, material, finger and managed tests pass for the repair.

issues.finding: Audited graph mesh references and non-helper body counts for all 233 suits across 219 original BDAE files. No additional omitted body descriptors or body-count mismatches were found. The stock importer's known Devil Spider errors remain explicit and are accepted only with hash-checked registered repair evidence.
issues.resolution: Source descriptor and body-count coverage passes. This does not replace raw skin fidelity checks or native visual acceptance.

issues.finding: Gwenom and Venom now retain both authored material slots and every original triangle. Both repaired assets passed full structural and 4196-frame animation tests, 115-frame web tests, exact texture and finger-policy checks, managed loading and individually reviewed native swing/grounded captures. Originals were hash-checked and fully backed up before replacement.
issues.resolution: Installed current per-material conversions. The material repair does not accept visual fist closure, source shader equivalence or tongue appearance in rear-view captures.

issues.additionalVisualConcern: Anti-Venom's rear-view apparent arm attachment is resolved: a native front-facing turn frame shows the tongue emerging from the mouth and hanging in front of the torso. All 150 tongue-weighted vertices stay head-relative across 4196 frames, with no body-mixed weights. No asset change was needed. Evidence: verification/targeted-anti-venom-tongue/review.json. This does not accept all tongue intersections or all poses.
issues.finding: Poison's distal tongue hook is corrected with a pose-only rotation. Source bind matrices, hierarchy, weights and chain lengths are preserved. All 4196 frames leave the mouth, body, fingers and 2816 unaffected vertices exactly unchanged. Native front and grounded-rear views show the revised silhouette. A new deep-crouch native capture visually matches the user's reported pose and shows the distal tip projecting outward rather than forming the tall upward hook. Its mouth is occluded from the rear; it does not replace front-view attachment evidence. See verification/targeted-poison-crouch/review.json. The refreshed attachment audit scans all 233 installed assets and passes all 4196 frames for 15 tongue-bearing suits, with mixed body/tongue vertices explicitly excluded from the rigid vertex invariant.
issues.next: Review remaining symbiote front/posed views; extend corrective policies only when supported by visual evidence. Poison's reported deep-crouch silhouette now has targeted coverage. Current attachment evidence is verification/head-appendages/installed-233.json, not visual intersection acceptance.

issues.finding: Both source FBXs contain only the standard two arm chains. The 356 upper extra-arm vertices are weighted only to the collarbones; there are no independent extra-arm or extra-finger chains to retarget. The observed rest pose is authored source behavior, not dropped rig data.
issues.resolution: Preserve source hierarchy and weights as requested. Independent extra-arm animation would require an explicitly authorized change to that source rig/weight policy.

issues.finding: Weighted finger reach contracts under the fist policy, but several native captures show claw-like or incompletely closed free hands. Numeric contraction is not proof of a visually closed fist. Devil Spider's measurement now passes after recovering its actual body. Black Suit Swiney Girl still has no vertices predominantly weighted to the selected distal joints, leaving a metric coverage gap, not proof that preserved weights are damaged.

rightHandContactFollowup.finding: The original right-hand audit is retained as historical evidence. Batch08 corrects only Arana Gymnast's right distal-middle rotation and Batty Brant's two right little-finger rotations. All sampled right-hand tip clearances are now positive, and full 4196-frame isolation proves left hands, other fingers, body, source geometry/weights/bind and all open poses unchanged. Two native frames per suit were inspected, including front/side right-glove views. Batty has a visible swing web; Arana's first frame is a jump and is not live web proof. These are targeted sampled-contact corrections, not exhaustive collision acceptance.

resolvedHeldBatch.diagnosis: Source-weighted digit tracing identifies the sideways tips as the index and little fingers. Their source spread survives shared-axis flexion. A source-relative aiming experiment reduces that spread without changing bind/weights/lengths, but completed native closeups still show a gap rather than a closed fist. Both candidates remain uninstalled despite passing all 55 structural checks, 4196-frame animation/isolation checks, 115-frame web checks and managed loading. Completed captures show jumping rather than swinging, so they are not live web-endpoint proof. Next: refine distal closure toward the palm and check for penetration before installation.
resolvedHeldBatch.finding: The original rejected staging and first aiming experiment remain historical and uninstalled. Arana Gymnast was repaired separately in repair-fists04. Black Cat Venom has source-hash-guarded separate hand settings, production native swing/crop acceptance and positive bilateral sampled tip clearance.
